instruction.text: Choose the room Raina Rainmaker is in.

feedback.end: Personal hygiene means keeping your body clean and healthy. Raina Rainmaker takes her personal hygiene very seriously. That is why she is getting ready in the bathroom.

instruction.text: Edgar hears a brushing noise coming from the bathroom. They need to get to rainmaking fast, what on earth is Raina doing?

b.sound: I am brushing my teeth and I will not be rushed! I need to keep my teeth healthy!
I am brushing my hair! I don’t want a hair out of place for rainmaking!

feedback.end: Raina is right, you need to keep your teeth healthy. Just like Raina, you should brush for 2 minutes twice a day.

instruction.text: Raina just finished using the toilet. What should she do before she leaves the bathroom?
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='1'>toilet_flush</voice> <break time='300ms'/> Raina just finished using the toilet. What should she do before she leaves the bathroom?

b.sound: Raina should wash her hands after using the toilet.
Raina should cut her toenails after using the toilet.

feedback.end: Toilets are not very clean. That is why you should follow Raina’s example. Always wash your hands after using the toilet.

instruction.text: Raina goes ahead and washes her hands. What is the most important thing for clean hands? Find it on the picture.

hint.text: The thing you are looking for makes bubbles!
hint.sound: ssml:The thing you are looking for<break time='50ms'/> makes bubbles!

feedback.end: The most important thing is soap. Soap gets rid of all the germs that can make you ill.

instruction.text: Raina quickly washes her hands and walks out of the bathroom. What does Edgar say?
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='1'>water_tap</voice> <break time='300ms'/> Raina quickly washes her hands and walks out of the bathroom. What does Edgar say?

b.sound: Raina, stop! You need to wash your hands for at least 20 seconds.
Hurry up, we need to get going.

feedback.end: Edgar is right. When you wash your hands, you need to use the soap for at least 20 seconds. To help you pass the time, count to 20 or sing a little song.

instruction.text: Raina is dripping with sweat and mud after a long day of rainmaking. Find and choose the part of the bathroom where she can clean her whole body.

feedback.end: That’s right, Raina should take a bath or shower to get rid of all the sweat and dirt. You should wash your body most days or whenever you are covered in dirt and sweat like Raina.

instruction.text: Edgar and Raina are about to eat. Raina asks if Edgar washed his hands before dinner. Choose Edgar’s response.

b.sound: I love dirt, I’m an earthworm! Why would I wash my hands?
That is a good point. It is very important to wash your hands before eating. I’ll head to the bathroom now.

feedback.end: Edgar is right. It is very important to wash your hands with soap before eating. That way you can prevent getting ill.
